title: Lessee operating lease — Quill Studio
instructions: On January 1, 2025, Quill Studio signed a five-year lease of office space, classified as an operating lease. Compute the amounts for its 2025 financial statements. Round to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.title: Lease terms
exhibits.content:
- Annual payments of **$50,000**, due each **December 31**, 2025–2029.
- Quill's incremental borrowing rate: **6%** (the rate implicit in the lease is not readily determinable).
- Initial direct costs paid by Quill: **$5,000**.
- Present value of an ordinary annuity of 1 for 5 periods at 6%: **4.21236**.

rows.label: Right-of-use asset at December 31, 2025
rows.explanation: Amortization = lease cost 51,000 − interest accretion 12,637 = 38,363; 215,618 − 38,363 = **177,255** (the liability plus 4,000 of unamortized initial direct costs).
